entities.name: Iglesia de San Andrés
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Iglesia de San Andrés is a parish church in San Martín del Rey Aurelio, Asturias, Spain. The Romanesque Revival-style building is situated in the urban area of El Entrego within the Linares parish of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Oviedo.
